earn.notes: Housing rate depends on non-housing spend vs housing each billing cycle: 25% 0.5X, 50% 0.75X, 75% 1X, 100%+ 1.25X; under 25%, flat 250 points. Pre-2027 accounts may elect Flexible Bilt Cash: 4% Bilt Cash, housing max 1X. Bilt Dining partners: up to 5X, varies.

rates.note: Link Bilt and Lyft accounts; book in the Lyft app.
Lowest tier: non-housing spend must reach 25% of housing in the billing cycle; 1.25X at 100%+. Below 25%: flat 250 points. Pay through Bilt app/site.

benefits.name: Hotel credit
benefits.notes: $400/year Bilt Travel Hotel credit: $200 Jan-Jun and $200 Jul-Dec on hotels booked through the Bilt Travel portal (bilt.com / Bilt app), 2-night minimum stay. Applied at checkout in the portal; unused credit does not roll over.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash
benefits.notes: $200 Bilt Cash deposited to your Bilt account on approval and then every January 1. Spent inside Bilt (dining, Lyft, Walgreens, Bilt Travel, rent/points unlocks); up to $100 rolls over, the rest expires Dec 31.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select
benefits.notes: Priority Pass membership for the cardholder and 2 guests (1,300+ lounges). Authorized users get their own membership.
